title: Colombia Update — May 19, 2026
summary: Colombia's Total Peace policy entered a deep institutional crisis as the Petro government's suspension of arrest warrants for 29 Clan del Golfo leaders was flatly refused by the Attorney General's Office, while the U.S. Embassy reminded Bogotá that Washington classifies the EGC as a terrorist organization. Pre-election violence escalated with two campaign staffers killed in Meta two weeks before the May 31 first-round presidential vote, where leftist Iván Cepeda leads polls at 44.3%.
